entities.name: Elena Ramírez Parra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elena Ramírez Parra is a Spanish botanist and researcher who studies the negative effects of environmental stress on plant growth. Applications of her research include improving harvest yield. In 2010, Ramírez won a L'Oréal-UNESCO Award for Women in Science.
